patch.objective: Planning migration and validation to Google Cloud: BigQuery Data Transfer Service, Database Migration Service, Transfer Appliance, Google Cloud networking, Datastream

sources.cite: Google Cloud, Professional Data Engineer exam guide v4.2: Designing data processing systems (~22%), Ingesting and processing the data (~25%), Storing the data (~20%), Preparing and using data for analysis (~15%), Maintaining and automating data workloads (~18%)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch of the PDF on 2026-11-17. Quoted: 3.1 'Planning for storage costs and performance'. The guide does not name partitioning or clustering. (read for this round by an earlier pass on 2026-11-17)

sources.cite: Google Cloud documentation, Database Migration Service for PostgreSQL: Promote a migration
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: promotion 'disconnects the destination instance from the source' and makes it 'an independent standalone primary'; before promoting, stop all writes, scripts and client connections to the source, check the replication delay metric and wait for it to reach zero or close to it; promoting earlier 'may affect destination data accuracy'; 'Database Migration Service doesn't migrate the pg_cron extension or its cron settings' (reinstall after promotion). The promote page (read 2026-11-18): promotion 'disconnects the destination instance from the source, transforms it into an independent standalone primary'; it describes no way to undo it, so the case treats promotion as final.
